Equipment:Closed Cooling Water Pump
 ABRBN "Centrifugal Pumps"
 Audoli & Berrtola Italy

This document outlines 
the major maintenance procedures P1, to be performed every five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the title block.

The
closed cooling pumps function to circulate the cooling water using for 
cooling the matrix components. They obtain from the compensation tank the water 
which flow to cool the components of the unit, pass to the heat exchanger and 
return to the pumps again in a closed circle

The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Abdel Azeem, 
reviewed by eng. Ahmed Fathy Yousef, tested by eng. 
Esam Hassan Darwesh, revised by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gelil: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director, 
accepted by eng. Mohamed Farag Anan: general manager, and approved by eng. 
Mohamed El-Sarrag: head sector of Damietta (3x135MW) PS.

This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC planning & financial 
 predicting head sector and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
A work permit must be issued.

The maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

items: A work permit must be issued.

The maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Isolate the CB of the pump motor.

Disconnect electric terminals of the pump 
 motor.

Isolate the pump mechanically by closing the 
 suction and delivery valves.
Be sure that the pump is completely drained.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid and rags.

Filler, vibrometer and dial 
 indicator.
Grease.

Check
 the vibration level of the pump and record it.

Check
 discharge, pressure and record them.
Check the alignment and record it.
Disconnect the motor.

Unbolt the coupling between the motor and the 
 pump.
Remove the motor.
Dismantle every pipe connecting to the pump.

Unscrew the hex screw ( 1 ), raise the washer 
 and raise the plate ( 3134 ).

Unscrew the screw ( 2 ) to raise the bearing 
 cover ( 3261 ) and then remove the radial shaft seal ring ( 4311 ).
Remove the ball bearing ( 3011 ).
Unbolt the oil dipstick ( 3859 ).
Unbolt the nuts ( 3 ) and the studs ( 3 ).
Raise the bearing bracket ( 3130 ).
Remove the ball bearing ( 3012 ).
Remove the radial shaft seal ring ( 4311 ).
Remove the bearing cover ( 3262 ).
Remove the flinger ( 2540 ).

Remove the stuffing box gland ( 4120 ) by 
 unscrewing the screw ( 4 ).

Remove the gland packing ( 4130 ), lantern 
 ring ( 4134 ), the gasket ( 4551 ) and the shaft sleeve ( 2450 ).

Unscrew the nut and the screw ( 5 ), raise the 
 pump cover ( 1222 ) and then remove the gasket ( 4521 ).

Raise the pump shaft with the impeller, remove 
 the key ( 6710 ) and unscrew the impeller nut ( 2912 ) to remove the impeller.
Remove the casing wear ring ( 1510 ).
Now the pump is completely disassembled.
Clean all parts of the pump.
Change all bearings of the pump.

Check all parts for any worn-out , replace the 
 damaged.

Check all parts for cracks, treat the cracks 
 by grinding or remachining.
Inspect the run-out of the shafts.
Change the wearing rings.

Measure the radial clearances for the pump and 
 adjust them.
Grease the bearings of the pump.
Clean all contact surfaces.

Assemble the impeller with the shaft by mounting the key ( 6710 ) and screw 
 the impeller nut ( 2912 ) to fix the impeller with the shaft
Put the lower wear ring ( 1510 ).
Put the upper wear ring ( 4521 ).

Assemble the pump cover ( 1222 ) and fix it with the pump casing by screw ( 5 
 ).

Put the shaft gasket ( 4551 ), the shaft sleeve ( 2450 ), the gland packing ( 
 4130 ) and lantern ring ( 4134 ).
Put the stuffing box gland ( 4120 ) and tight the screw ( 4 ).
Assemble the bearing bracket ( 3130 ) by bolting the bolt and nut ( 3 ).
Assemble the flinger ( 2540 ).
Assemble the radial shaft seal ring ( 4311 ).
Assemble the bearing cover ( 3262 ) and tight the screw ( 6 ).
Assemble the ball bearing ( 3012 ).
Tight the oil dipstick ( 3859 ).
Assemble the ball bearing ( 3011 ).

Put the radial shaft seal ring ( 4311 ), put the bearing cover ( 3261 ) and 
 then tight the screw ( 2 ).
Put the plate ( 3134 ), put the washer and tight the screw ( 1 ).

Mount the coupling between the pump shaft and the motor shaft, adjust the 
 alignment and then fix the coupling.
Now, the pump is completely assembled.
Check the water level in the compensation tank.
Open the suction and delivery valves of the pump.
